Excerpts E11 and E12 describe cervical radiculopathy exacerbated by tumors or physical therapy-resistant but note pain worsening with movement. If pain is 'unchanged,' this contrasts with expected symptom behavior, supporting rule_out.

Excerpts for subclavian steal syndrome and related thoracic outlet conditions mention positional changes in imaging (E18, E20) but none explicitly connect pain to head/neck position. Findings do not directly address this criterion.

Excerpts E17 and E18 describe the Adson test requiring head/neck extension to assess thoracic outlet syndrome. If symptoms (pain) are 'unchanged' by position, it contradicts the expected response during this diagnostic maneuver, ruling it out.
